A NOTE FOR THE GROWN-UPS

Little tool.
Thoughtful play.

Designed without a sharp metal blade. Still a tool to explore together, with an adult nearby.

What is it made for?

A colorful, 3D printed folding pocket tool for supervised exploration and imaginative play. It isn't a cutting tool.

Is it suitable for my child?

The blade is unsharpened, but the product has a pointed shape and a moving hinge. Adult supervision is needed. Keep away from mouths, eyes, and very young children. An age rating and safety certification have not yet been established.

How big is it?

The orange tool shown beside the ruler is approximately 5.5 inches long when open. Please use the actual product photos as your reference.

How do payment and shipping work?

Each tool is $15, plus $4.99 flat-rate shipping per order. Any applicable tax will be confirmed before payment. Online ordering is getting ready to launch. Nothing is charged when you add an item to your bag.
